title: 第1281章 永生种之力第1280章 返璞归真
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
第1281章永生种之力
“永生种的力量……出现了！”
在永生种的力量降临那一刻，各方大修皆有感知。
埋藏于心底的贪婪欲望被不自觉的勾起，呼吸都变得急促，想要下场去争夺。
唯一通往永恒的力量，太诱人了！
咚——！
连早已做好准备的李元去接受这股力量时，也是难以抑制的兴奋。
仿佛身体灵魂的每一颗粒子都在为之跳动。
这股力量，太令人着迷了！
驾驭并融合这股力量，李元的第一个念头便是天上地下，唯我独尊！自信与狂妄由心而起。
永生种的力量渗透进他的每一寸血肉、每一条经脉、每一个窍穴，而后是神魂，甚至是心灵意识。
此等力量，超越了太初界的一切规则，不被任何形态所拘束，不受丝毫的因果限制。
它明明是诞生于太初界的力量，却给予李元一种它不属于界内任何生灵的错觉。
即使此刻的李元已经掌握了永生种，依然觉得不是自己得到了永恒的力量，而是被赐予了永恒。
这不像是证道，更像是既定的果位，但杂乱的思绪很快就被浩瀚力量带来的爽感所冲散。
嗡！嗡！嗡！
不仅是李元本身，连他的本命蛊以及数不尽从属蛊都得到了永生种的加持。
每一只蛊虫的形态未变，内在的‘神’却不一样了。
李元看似还在被速度快到无法捕捉，进入‘大道至简、返璞归真’状态的至尊仙胎压着打，局势却已经发生了微妙的反转。
至尊仙胎的速度还在加快，力量更是达到了震荡混沌的程度，但对李元造成的伤害已是越来越低。

永生种之力加身，只是被迫的防守，就已经展现出超乎寻常的强大。
李元沉浸其中。
他开始学会适应，进一步化用永生种之力。
第一个淬炼的便是盘仙。
九大本命蛊中，除了本就是永生种掌控者的剑仙子外，盘仙最能承受住这股力量的影响。
或者说，盘仙一直不吃压力。
什么力量给盘仙都能用，反正用自己的力量也会发狂。
融永生，形不变，神变！
当盘仙蛊再次钻入李元的脊骨，李元的眼神彻底疯狂了，身体在燃烧，连带着周身的混沌大道本源都在烧。
仿佛这片天地都化作了它的燃料。
归真状态的至尊仙胎再次杀来，李元猛地身形一定，同时出手，一拳轰出。
这一拳，同样有大道至简，返璞归真之势，但还蕴含着另一种力量。
这一拳，结结实实打中了至尊仙胎。
咔嚓！
碎裂的声音在虚空中震响，清脆又清晰。
因为这一拳，打穿了仙胎的襁褓，连天道护持在永生种面前也失去了作用。
这一拳也震撼了观战的无数大修。
很显然，两个人的一场大战，已经代表太初界的最高水准，穷尽一切的大战，都用上了不属于自身的伟力。
永生种，永恒唯一！
终是不可抗衡。

哪怕是完全体的至尊仙胎，依旧抵挡不住这份力量。
李元也终于理解，为什么当初的青冥能够在举世皆敌的情况下硬生生杀出一条血路，击杀多位大修了。
content_en:
Chapter 1281 The Power of the Immortal Seed
"The power of the immortal seed... appears!"
The moment the power of the Immortal Seed arrived, all major repairmen felt it.
The greedy desire buried deep in my heart was unconsciously aroused, my breathing became rapid, and I wanted to fight for it.
The only power leading to eternity is so tempting!
Boom——!
Even Li Yuan, who had been prepared for a long time, was uncontrollably excited when he went to accept this power.
It seems that every particle of the body and soul is beating for it.
This power is so fascinating!
After harnessing and integrating this power, Li Yuan's first thought was that I am the only one in heaven and earth! Confidence and arrogance arise from the heart.
The power of the immortal seed penetrated into every inch of his flesh and blood, every meridian, every acupuncture point, and then into his soul and even his spiritual consciousness.
This kind of power transcends all the rules of Taichu Realm, is not bound by any form, and is not subject to any causal restrictions.
It was obviously a power born in the Taichu Realm, but it gave Li Yuan the illusion that it did not belong to any living being in the world.
Even though Li Yuan has mastered the eternal seed at this moment, he still feels that he has not obtained eternal power, but has been given eternity.
This didn't feel like enlightenment, more like an established attainment status, but the messy thoughts were quickly dissipated by the refreshing feeling brought by the vast power.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Not only Li Yuan himself, but also his natal Gu and countless subordinate Gu were blessed by the immortal species.
The form of each Gu insect remains unchanged, but the inner 'god' is different.
Li Yuan seemed to be still being beaten by the Supreme Immortal Fetus who was too fast to catch and had entered the state of 'returning to simplicity and returning to nature', but the situation had already undergone a subtle reversal.
The speed of the Supreme Immortal Fetus is still accelerating, and its power has reached the level of shaking chaos, but the damage caused to Li Yuan is getting lower and lower.
With the power of the Immortal Seed added to his body, he was just forced to defend, but he already showed extraordinary power.
Li Yuan was immersed in it.
He began to learn to adapt and further utilize the power of the eternal seed.
The first person to be tempered was Panxian.
Among the nine natal Gu, apart from the Sword Fairy who is the controller of the Immortal Seed, Panxian is the most able to withstand the influence of this power.
In other words, Panxian has never been under pressure.
Panxian can use whatever power he has, but he will go crazy if he uses his own power anyway.
Integrate eternal life, the form remains unchanged, and the spirit changes!
When the Panxian Gu penetrated Li Yuan's spine again, Li Yuan's eyes were completely crazy, his body was burning, and the origin of the Chaos Avenue around him was burning.
It was as if the whole world had turned into its fuel.
The Supreme Immortal Fetus in the state of returning to his true form came to kill again. Li Yuan suddenly stabilized his body, and at the same time he took action and punched out.
This punch also has the potential to bring simplicity and return to nature, but it also contains another kind of power.
This punch hit the Supreme Immortal Fetus firmly.
Click!
The shattering sound resounded in the void, crisp and clear.
Because this punch penetrated the swaddling clothes of the immortal fetus, even the protection of heaven lost its effect in front of the immortal species.
This punch also shocked countless overhauls watching the battle.
Obviously, a battle between two people has represented the highest level of Taichu Realm. All the battles have involved the use of great power that does not belong to oneself.
The eternal seed, the only one forever!
It is ultimately irresistible.
Even the complete Supreme Immortal Fetus still cannot resist this power.
Li Yuan finally understood why Qing Ming was able to cut his way out and kill many major cultivators when he was surrounded by enemies all over the world.
